sql:
with lf as (
 select fl.market_ticker mt, lo.strategy, min(fl.filled_at) ff, sum(fl.quantity) q, round(avg(fl.price),1) px, min(fl.side) side
 from fills fl join live_orders lo on lo.kalshi_order_id=fl.kalshi_order_id
 where fl.market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' group by 1,2
), ps as (
 select market_ticker mt, string_agg(distinct status,',') pstat, max(resolved_value) rv, max(closed_at) pclosed,
  sum(case when pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) ploss
 from paper_trades where market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' group by 1
)
select lf.*, ps.pstat, ps.rv, ps.pclosed, ps.ploss, s.close_time
from lf left join ps on ps.mt=lf.mt left join mmsell_settlement_meta s on s.market_ticker=lf.mt
order by ff
